Title: Cam and Sab titles and Clan Impersonation (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Kevin Masterson
Messages.Body:
We had a question the other night and was wondering if someone and
hoepfully LSJ could answer it.

What happens if a Cam or Sab vamp with a title such as Prince uses
Clan Impersonation. Do they lose their title, keep it but have no
votes (for contesting a title), lose the title but have votes ala
Independant vamps and so on.

Thanx in advance.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <96dcffb8.01122...@posting.google.com>, Kevin

Masterson <umbr...@rocketmail.com> writes:
>What happens if a Cam or Sab vamp with a title such as Prince uses
>Clan Impersonation. Do they lose their title, keep it but have no
>votes (for contesting a title), lose the title but have votes ala
>Independant vamps and so on.

The title remains there, but is effectively dormant.

When they change back to an appropriate clan/sect, it reactivates. If,
in the meantime, someone claims that (contestable) title, the CI-ed
vampire immediately loses theirs.

e.g.

A Ventrue Justicar CIs to Gangrel. The title is dormant, until they
change back to Ventrue. (Because it requires a clan.)

The Prince of Paris changes clan to Sabbat. The title is dormant.
Dimple is elected Prince of Paris. The CIed Sabbat vampire immediately
gives up their dormant title so even if they change back, they don't get
it.

The Lasombra Archbishop of New York CIs to Ravnos. (Dormant.) They
then CI to Tzimisce. Because none of the Sabbat titles are tied to a
clan, just a sect, the title reactivates.
